What questions about seismic activity around Anchorage could we investigate using machine learning?

Now that you have access to seismic data collected around Anchorage and a machine learning model that can help you identify signals, there are many possibilities for what you can investigate. In this lesson, you will have the chance to explore the data to discover patterns in seismic data.

First, based on what you know about how the WaveRunner works from the last few lessons, what questions do you think you could explore with the data?
